pages.title: CBSE Class 10 — two board exams from 2026–27

facts.text: From: academic year 2026–27; aligned with NEP 2020
facts.head: News

facts.text: First exam: mid-February — mandatory; results by April
facts.head: News

facts.text: Second exam: May — optional, improvement in up to three subjects (Science, Maths, Social Science, two languages); results by June
facts.head: News

facts.text: Better of the two scores counts
facts.head: News

facts.text: Essential Repeat: failed or absent in 3+ subjects — ⚠ cannot take second exam
facts.head: News

facts.text: Compartment: 1–2 subjects — can use second exam
facts.head: News

pages.title: Organ transplantation programme — Health Ministry report

facts.text: Report: Union Health Ministry, 19 June 2025
facts.head: News

facts.text: Kidney transplants 2024-25: only 13,476 vs demand over 1 lakh
facts.head: News

facts.text: Gaps: no dedicated transplant OTs/TICUs; no in-house HLA cross-matching labs in many AIIMS; delays in Brain-Stem Death (BSD) Committees; manpower shortage
facts.head: News

facts.text: Finance: AB PM-JAY does not cover liver and heart transplants or long-term immunosuppressants
facts.head: News

facts.text: Recommendations: new govt transplant centres, HLA labs, include liver/heart in PM-JAY, case-based incentives for teams, mandatory data sharing with NOTTO
facts.head: News
